column1: # tools/o0check.py --expected: differences the checker accepts, with a reason.  Columns (TAB-separated): width  kind  tu  name  reason

#   tu     object basename without .o (work side), glob allowed
#   name   mangled function / section / symbol / type name, glob allowed
